caption: The drawing depicts a single pitcher positioned upright in the center of a plain, off-white background. The pitcher is rendered in shades of brown and reddish-brown, giving it a metallic, slightly reflective appearance. It has a rounded body with a narrow neck and a wide, slightly flared lip. A thin, curved handle is attached near the top, extending outward and looping downward. Some text is faintly visible on the upper portion of the pitcher. Below and to the right of the pitcher, the name "NORMAN HENRY YECKLEY" is handwritten in a reddish-brown color matching the pitcher. There are no other objects or decorative elements in the composition, and the background remains unadorned.
title: Copper Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
